_what_this_is: A hand-written arm A transcript over three queries of evals/docs-retrieval/queries/fixture-catalog.jsonl. No agent produced it and its usage figures are invented. It exists so evals/docs-retrieval/arm-a/score-transcript.mjs can be exercised without invoking an agent, which is how arm A's scorer is verified on a branch that runs arm A not at all.
_the_three_cases: q-fc-verify-callback returns the labelled section first; q-fc-billable-weight returns it third, written with a leading './' and surrounding whitespace so the scorer's normalisation is exercised; q-fc-negative-lattice answers 'none' against a negative query, which is the abstention agent-task.md asks for.
_it_is_not_a_measurement: Nothing in docs/retrieval-eval-results.md is taken from this file. A real transcript is produced by evals/docs-retrieval/arm-a/run-arm-a.sh, by hand, per the procedure in docs/retrieval-eval.md.
